LightningComponentBundle.description: To display Related objects details on a detail page

property.name: criteriaFieldAPIName
property.label: Reference FieldAPIName
property.description: The field on which query to be performed. e.g. it can be AccountId from which Case records will be fetched.

property.name: hideColumnIfNoData
property.label: Hide Column If No Data
property.description: Comma separated field API names. A column is hidden when none of the displayed rows have a value for that field. Example: Core_MDF_Comments__c,Core_MDF_Notes__c

property.name: componentVisibilityCriteria
property.label: Component Visibility Criteria
property.description: Semicolon separated SOQL conditions evaluated against the current record. The component is hidden unless the record matches. Example: Core_MDF_Program_Type__c = 'IPA';Core_MDF_Program_Type__c = 'CoGTM';Core_MDF_Active_Ind__c = true

property.name: componentVisibilityCriteriaLogic
property.label: Component Visibility Criteria Logic
property.description: Combines the conditions above by their position number (1-based). Supports AND, OR and parentheses for grouping. Leave blank to AND all conditions. Example: 1 AND (2 OR 3)

property.name: messageBelowTable
property.label: Message Below Table
property.description: Optional. Field API name whose distinct values across all rows are consolidated and shown as text below the table. Example: Core_MDF_Footer_Message__c
